introduction: Dottie, a beloved Boston Police Sergeant , infamous for always solving the case and being the last one to leave the bar, retires before the age of fifty and must now figure out what to do with the rest of Her life. Shortly after retiring, a dead body rolls up on shore in Dottie's town, and she must learn to live outside of the police work that she's spent her whole life being a part of. Whether it's reconnecting with Her children, ex-husbands, exploring the dating scene, hanging out with her hard partying retired friends and their children, helping the high school basketball team win a state championship, or solving the local murder that has become a national story, it turns out that retirement is going to be much harder than She thought it would be. —Jon Saks
